sub_sector.value: Freight railcars; railcar rebuilding; aftermarket parts and service

manufacturing_type.detail: Welds and assembles steel, aluminum and hybrid freight cars at its Castaños plant.

production_model.detail: Designs and builds railcars to customer requirements. Stocks aftermarket parts.

product_complexity.detail: Custom railcar designs use patented features and proprietary welding to meet structural and performance requirements.

production_role.detail: Builds finished freight cars, converts and rebodies existing railcars, and supplies aftermarket parts and field support.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves freight rail customers and lessors with cars for bulk commodities and containerized freight.

notes: The evidence leaves it unclear whether FreightCar America manufactures its stocked replacement parts.
